1.12b.name: MiniSat
1.12b.license_source: LICENSE file of the archive, an MIT licence signed Niklas Een and Niklas Sorensson
1.12b.comment: The release of the SAT 2005 competition era, the version the paper "An Extensible SAT-solver" describes.
1.12b.status_detail: The release prints no model and takes no result file, only the words SATISFIABLE or UNSATISFIABLE; its launcher gives the s line, so the UNSAT check passes and the SAT model check cannot.

1.14.license_source: LICENSE file of the archive, an MIT licence signed Niklas Een and Niklas Sorensson
1.14.comment: Last release of the 1.x series, the one most hacks of the competitions start from.

1.14c.name: MiniSat
1.14c.license_source: LICENSE file of the archive, an MIT licence signed Niklas Een and Niklas Sorensson
1.14c.comment: A translation of 1.14 into plain C, published next to it. It takes no result file and numbers its model from zero, so its launcher translates that into the competition format.

1.14p.license_source: LICENSE file of the archive, an MIT licence signed Niklas Een and Niklas Sorensson
1.14p.comment: The proof-logging variant of 1.14, an ancestor of today's DRAT proofs.
